_schema: Rule 13 debt ledger, read by tools/check_security.py. One entry per (file, label). An entry is a PROMISE with a date: expired -> the gate goes red; fixed -> the gate goes red until the entry is deleted. Never add an entry without a reason the user has seen.

debt.label: plaintext-grpc
debt.reason: Service-to-service gRPC has no TLS yet; the only boundary is a NetworkPolicy that deploy/README.md says is not applied to the live cluster. Carries the staff session token on the identity hop.

debt.label: plaintext-grpc
debt.reason: Same channel as identityclient: plaintext gRPC to service-platform, which holds every commune's directory.

debt.label: grpc-plaintext-operator-channel
debt.reason: Người dùng chốt 01/10/2026: chung nợ kênh gRPC nội cụm (mang mật khẩu, TOTP, token vận hành). Cùng ngày chủ dự án cho khu vận hành lên sống TRƯỚC ba điều kiện từng đặt ở đây (netpol quy tắc 3 hẹp theo cặp gọi, netpol áp trên cụm thật, ADR 0048 mục #12) — rủi ro đã nhận ghi ở ADR 0048 §Chốt triển khai 01/10/2026. Kênh này chỉ còn NetworkPolicy che cho tới khi trả nợ; hạn không đổi.

debt.label: non-crypto-random
debt.reason: Legitimate: rand.IntN picks which ClamAV host to try first (load spreading), no secret derives from it. Convert to an inline `// @security-exception:` comment the next time the file is edited, then delete this entry.

debt.label: missing-security-headers
debt.reason: next.config.ts sets no CSP, HSTS, nosniff, Referrer-Policy or framing header, and neither does the ingress. Priority P0 in kb/90-ephemeral/tcvn-14423-danh-gia.md (K9).
